question.problem:
$$
{{[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & -5 \\ 12 & 9 & 0 \\ 9 & 7 & -12\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{A}={{[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 4 & 1 & 0 \\ 3 & \boxed{} & 1\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{L}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & -5 \\ 0 & 1 & 20 \\ 0 & 0 & -17\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{U}
$$

Consider the LU factorization of the matrix $A$ above. What is the value of the entry ${l}_{32}$ in the matrix $L?$
question.worked_solution:
The matrix $U$ in the LU decomposition is obtained from the original matrix $A$ by row-reducing using Gaussian elementation. In particular, to make zeros below the main diagonal, we proceed as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & -5 \\ 12 & 9 & 0 \\ 9 & 7 & -12\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-4){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & -5 \\ 0 & 1 & 20 \\ 9 & 7 & -12\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-3){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & -5 \\ 0 & 1 & 20 \\ 0 & 1 & 3\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we want to make $0$ at the position ${a}_{32}$ using Gaussian elimination. To do this, we take the $3$rd row of $A,$ and we add the $2$nd row of $A$ multiplied by $-1:$

$$
\begin{aligned} & \,\,[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & -5 \\ 0 & 1 & 20 \\ 0 & 1 & 3\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-1){R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & -5 \\ 0 & 1 & 20 \\ 0 & 0 & -17\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

The entry ${l}_{32}$ of the matrix $L$ is the factor next to ${R}_{2},$ taken with the opposite sign:

$$
{l}_{32}=-(-1)=1.
$$
